tvdb.title: Showdown! Cleaning Match
tvdb.synopsis: Paradise Academy's annual event, the School Cleaning Match, is being held. It's a cleaning contest between teams. Juria and Elle, who tend to fight, end up forming separate teams to compete against each other. Meanwhile, Himari and Mitsuki, who have each become leaders of different teams, are cleaning together with their palm-sized stuffed animals, "Puri Usa" and "Puri Neko". However, Tsumugi is jealous of Himari and Mitsuki who only show affection for the palm-sized stuffed animals, and runs off somewhere with the chicks that Mr. Matsuoka keeps. Will Himari and Mitsuki be able to find Tsumugi? And what will be the outcome of the cleaning match?

tvdb.title: The Secret AiPri Contest
tvdb.synopsis: Princess Ring's butler, Shitsumu, makes an important announcement. The first Eye Puri Contest will be held! It's a contest to decide the world's best eye puri that will make Princess Ring's heart flutter, sparkle and be thrilled. The winner will be given an eternal outfit. To qualify, the "Ring Gauge" must be filled up. However, Himari and Mitsuki don't have much saved up... This time, the key is to succeed in the "Jewel Buzzrium Change" that Juria and El showed them. Mitsuki and Himari immediately go to ask Juria and El how to change into a Jewel Buzzrium, but...

tvdb.title: Two People After the Rain
tvdb.synopsis: Ever since seeing Himari and Mitsuki's live performance, Juria has become interested in duos. Eru has also been writing a novel with a duo theme. Encouraged by Mitsuki's words, Eru tries to invite Juria to join a duo. However, Juria has already received an invitation from another Aipri member. Eru is shocked to see Juria looking so happy. Juria encourages Eru, who is feeling down, and calls her out on a rainy day. However, the two get into a huge fight when Eru says she "doesn't like" a song that Juria loves at all...

tvdb.title: The Aipri Contest Begins!
tvdb.synopsis: Himari and Mitsuki are still depressed after failing to perform the Jewel Buzzlume Change. Mitsuki invites Himari to start training. However, worried that Mitsuki is pushing herself too hard, Chii gives Himari some advice. Himari tries to cheer Mitsuki up by organizing a "Mitsuki Love Party" filled with all of Mitsuki's favorite things. Can Mitsuki recover? Meanwhile, the first Aipri Contest begins. Their opponents are the duo "Love Juriel", consisting of Julia and Elle. Who will be the winner?

tvdb.title: Princess Ring Appears
tvdb.synopsis: Himari and Mitsuki, winners of the first AiPri contest, will perform a debut live show in front of Princess Ring. Unable to hide their nervousness, the two join up with Julia and Elle and finally head to the palace where Princess Ring is. However, only those who are recognized by the princess at this live show will be able to meet Princess Ring. The Love Juliet duo perform a live show with excitement at full throttle. Poppin' Dreamin' also performs a dignified live show worthy of the name Star AiPri. After the two groups put on a fantastic live show, Princess Ring Clover finally appears before them...

tvdb.title: The Rumored Transfer Student
tvdb.synopsis: A certain Aipri is very popular in Aipriverse right now. Apparently he is produced by a very talented producer, but he hasn't had any live shows recently. Meanwhile, Nanaura Subaru transfers to Paradise Academy, class 1A. However, because of his blunt and silent attitude, everyone around him is scared of him. Hiiro, who was walking in a hurry down the hallway, bumps into Subaru. Hiiro is scared, but when Subaru picks up something he's lost, he is surprised. However, Hinata sees what is happening. Hinata thinks that Subaru is scaring her sister, so she challenges him to a soccer match, but...

tvdb.title: A Single Secret
tvdb.synopsis: A famous singing teacher from overseas said that he wanted to produce Mitsuki. Mitsuki wants to take on the challenge, but is worried about leaving Himari behind. Himari is also sad to see Mitsuki go, but wants to support her friend's dream. Since then, Himari has started to work hard to be able to do everything on her own so that Mitsuki won't worry. After listening to Subaru and Wako's talk, Mitsuki has started to become conscious of her "new self." Will Mitsuki and Himari be separated like this?

tvdb.title: Otome the Producer
tvdb.synopsis: Subaru has started singing again as an AiPri member. He is practicing alone, but the repertoire is not one that producer OtoP thought up, but something he came up with herself. Meanwhile, a transfer student, Nanaura Otome, comes to Himari and Mitsuki's class. She produces Paradise Academy to make school life more enjoyable. She also knows a lot about AiPri. Her true identity is Subaru's producer, OtoP. Himari and Mitsuki are surprised. However, when Subaru finds Otome, he suddenly runs away for some reason...

tvdb.title: Fly! Jumping Rocket
tvdb.synopsis: The second Ai-Pri Contest is announced. Himari, who has not yet been able to change into Space Buzzrium, is full of enthusiasm. Meanwhile, Otome tells Subaru that she does not need to enter the contest. Subaru tells her clearly that he wants to graduate from Otome's production. However, Otome insists that "absolutely not" and runs away without listening to what he has to say. Mitsuki, who gives Subaru advice, finds out that Otome and Subaru are from Ai-Pri School. Apparently, Otome was taking singing lessons at the time, but she had a "secret."

tvdb.title: My Melody and Kuromi Are Here
tvdb.synopsis: Himari, Mitsuki, and Tsumugi meet My Melody at the AiPriverse. The three become friends and make a guest appearance on the "AiPri♪My Melody Channel" broadcast. The event is to give advice to the My Melody friends on their troubles. Then, Kuromi appears! Kuromi answers the My Melody friends' troubles by saying, "Just be like me!" But how can we become like Kuromi? When asked, Kuromi tries to teach Himari and the other AiPri how to "be like Kuromi"...

tvdb.title: A Friend's Smile
tvdb.synopsis: When Jumpin' Rocket decides to enter the second Aipri Contest, Shitsumu announces that they will be eligible to enter by the end of the day. Unlike Mitsuki, Himari is not yet able to change into a Space Buzzrium and feels anxious. At that time, Umi, a first-year elementary school student and classmate Nagisa's younger sister, comes to class 2A. Umi says she is a big fan of Aipri Himari. However, she gets into a fight with Nagisa and runs out of the classroom. When Himari finds out that tomorrow is Umi's "day to work hard at the hospital," she chases after her as the deadline for the contest approaches...

tvdb.title: An Aimu Gathering
tvdb.synopsis: The final exams are over at Paradise Academy, and summer vacation is just around the corner. Mitsuki is writing a letter to someone. Himari wants to perform a live show, but Aipriverse is currently under maintenance. At Aipriverse, Aimu and the others are making a big fuss, saying that a ghost has appeared. As everyone tries to find out the true identity of the ghost, Aimu and the others end up becoming engrossed in Aipri's live show. However, in the midst of all this, the true identity of the ghost is finally revealed...

tvdb.synopsis: Finally, the 2nd Aipri Contest was held. Even before the live show, Otome is distributing Jumpin Rocket with Subaru to enliven the Pritomo and others. And finally, the contest begins. Both Mitsuki and Jumpin Rocket showed great performances. The one who wins is the one who enlivens more Pritomo. Which hand will win the championship...!?

tvdb.title: Mitsuki and the Start of Summer
tvdb.synopsis: The debut live performance of Eternal Space Coord is held. Subaru and Otome of Jumpin' Rocket show off a dazzling performance. The theme of the 3rd Aipri Contest is announced as "Animal Buzzlume Change". After "excitement" and "longing", what emotion will be the key next? Researching Buzzlume Change, training Aipri, a summer vacation... Chii proposes a summer training camp for the Aipri club to do it all.

tvdb.title: Would You Like Delichiious Shaved Ice?
tvdb.synopsis: During the summer vacation, the "Aipri training camp" of the Aipri club has started. Chii runs a shaved ice shop in the sea with Vivi. Vivi is a first-year junior high school student who yearns for Ipri. Himari and the others are all playing on the beach. Then Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin appeared from the sea! He temporarily returned home from studying abroad to be a special coach for the training camp. On the other hand, Vivi helped the shaved ice shop and said, "I don't like myself, so I want to be Chii-chan." In the meantime, Chii, who worked too hard on the work of the student council and the work of the shaved ice shop, collapsed...

tvdb.title: Tsumugi and the Summer Fest
tvdb.synopsis: During the summer vacation "AiPri Training Camp," Sakura and the others are conducting rigorous training. Tsumugi watches Himari and the others as they work hard. During the Aipri Birthday, energy is returning to Tsumugi's Aipri Brace. Upon learning this, Himari invites them to do a live performance right away, but Tsumugi says she wants to do a special live performance. In order to revive Secret Friends ∞, a summer festival "Aipri the Summer" is being held, produced by Oto-P!

tvdb.title: Vivi is Chii's Brightest Disciple
tvdb.synopsis: Vivi, who has become Chii's number one pupil, joins the AiPri club. Although she doesn't have an AiPri bracelet yet, Vivi desperately tries to keep up with the intensive training at the AiPri training camp. However, she pushes herself until she is completely exhausted and is scolded by Chii. Just as Vivi is feeling down, her advisor, Sarashina-sensei, appears and gives her an AiPri bracelet. Overjoyed, Vivi joins the AiPri-birth. Her registration as an AiPri is complete, and it's finally time for the live performance. However, when it's her turn to perform, Vivi doesn't appear on stage...

tvdb.title: All-Out Match! Vivi vs Chii
tvdb.synopsis: Vivi, who made a shocking debut, is being talked about among the PriTomos members as a possible winner of the 3rd Aipri Grand Prix. However, Chii is cold towards Vivi. In fact, she has been feeling anxious about Vivi, who achieved the Buzzlume Change at her debut live show. Sakura tells Chii, "There's something you're missing right now." Meanwhile, Vivi, wanting to be recognized by Chii, challenges Chii to a showdown. What will be the outcome of this showdown between master and disciple?

episodes.title: Episodio 22

Himari and the others are trying out a live performance to qualify for the 3rd AiPri Contest. Himari, Mitsuki, and Tsumugi from Secret Friends ∞ successfully complete the Animal Buzzlume Change and secure their place in the contest. Chii tries with ease, but unfortunately fails to change into Buzzlume. Chii has lost sight of who she is...

Himari has heard from Yakumo that Mitsuki has treasured a ring since she was little. Together with the members of the Ai-Pri Club, she begins to prepare for the birthday party. Will the surprise birthday party be a success?

However, Himari and Mitsuki can barely keep up with Tsumugi, who is showing off an incredible performance unlike anything they've ever seen before. After achieving the Animal Buzzrium Change, the two give a performance that is full of "true self" and confidence. However, the debut live show doesn't end there. Ring Princess, moved by their performance, says she will "give you a reward"...!?

tvdb.synopsis: The school principal and Nonose-san visit the Aipri Club. They tell them about an Aipri contest that was held only once in the past. In that contest, one Aipri won by successfully performing five Buzzrium Changes, which was called the "Princess's Miracle." However, it is unknown who the winning Aipri was. Himari and the others look at the records of their previous live performances to try to get to the bottom of the mystery.

tvdb.synopsis: Having missed out on the win in the last AiPri Contest and feeling frustrated, Tsumugi is currently training hard for the next contest. "I want to be a flower that sparkles more, that gives courage," she says, and so she goes alone to meet Princess Ring. Tsumugi asks what she should do to give a live performance that is as sparkling and cute as Princess Ring. Princess Ring decides to conduct a secret test to see if Tsumugi's feelings are genuine. Dressed in her school uniform, Tsumugi arrives at Paradise Academy, an Ai-Priverse school created by Princess Ring. What exactly is the content of the test...?

tvdb.synopsis: Chii is investigating the secret of Princess Ring. She hasn't figured anything out yet, but Mitsuki says she remembers something. When she was little, the first Aipri Princess Mitsuki dreamed of was Princess Ring. Thinking this, Mitsuki searches for a memorable picture drawn by Himari. However, when she finds it, she tears it up. Meanwhile, Princess Ring gives the Aipri Princesses a "secret test." Mitsuki is unable to concentrate, worried about the picture she tore. While Himari and the others are taking their respective tests, Mitsuki meets her younger self...

episodes.synopsis: アイプリグラムの『アイプリスマホ占い』にハマっているひまり。すると、クラスメイトの如月いちかが声をかけてくる。いちかも大の占い好きなのだ。そんな彼女は、みつきに聞きたいことがあると言う。なんと、占いで八雲が『運命の人』と出たらしい。卒業したら『ドリームスター学園』に進学したいという八雲の夢を聞いたいちかは、自分も同じ学校に行くと宣言。だが幼なじみのなぎさは、勉強が苦手ないちかが心配。ずっと一緒にいたいと思っていたなぎさは、みつきとひまりに相談するのだが……。

tvdb.synopsis: Himari is obsessed with fortune telling. Then her classmate, Ichika Kisaragi, calls out to her. Ichika is also a big fan of fortune telling. She says she has something she wants to ask Mitsuki. Apparently, her fortune told her that Yakumo is her "soulmate." After hearing Yakumo's dream of attending Dream Star Academy after graduation, Ichika declares that she will also go to the same school. However, her childhood friend, Nagisa, is worried about Ichika, who is not good at studying. Nagisa has always wanted to be with her, so she consults Mitsuki and Himari, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: じゅりあとえるはハロウィンの実行委員になり、楽しいパーティーを企画。つむぎはパラダイス学園で開かれるハロウィンパーティーにリング姫を誘う。「楽しそう」と思ったとき、リング姫はプリこーんのぬいぐるみとなり、パラダイス学園へ。おかし交換やお化けの仮装など、プリこーんとしてハロウィンパーティーを見て回るリング姫。そんな中、実行委員だったじゅりあとえるがケンカしているのを見てしまう。えるはプリこーんに、じゅりあへの素直な気持ちを語る。そこにやってきたじゅりあに向かって、素直な想いをぶつけるえる。ちゃんと仲直りできた二人は、そのままアイプリライブをする。その後、宮殿に帰ってきたリング姫。ラブジュリエルへのライブリクエストは、実はリング姫からのものだったのだ。リング姫の楽しそうな顔を初めて見て、驚くつむぎだった。

tvdb.synopsis: Juria and Elle become Halloween executive committee members and plan a fun party. Tsumugi invites Princess Ring to the Halloween party being held at Paradise Academy. When she thinks it sounds fun, Princess Ring turns into a Pricon stuffed animal and heads to Paradise Academy. Princess Ring goes around the Halloween party as Pricon, exchanging sweets and dressing up as ghosts. Meanwhile, she sees Juria and El, who are also on the executive committee, fighting...

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: つむぎは、リング姫の元を訪れる。まだまだ知らないことがたくさんあると言うリング姫。つむぎはそんな彼女に「いろんなことを教えてあげる」と言い、次の日のお昼に会う約束をした。つむぎはもっといろんなことを勉強するため、ムギちゃんの姿でパラダイス学園の図書室に行く。リング姫にもっとたくさんのことを教えてあげたいと張り切るつむぎ。しかし本に夢中になるあまり、リング姫との約束を忘れてしまう。約束を破ってしまったつむぎは、リング姫の元に謝りに行く。しかし、会ってもらえないつむぎは、プリンセスの姿になり、自分の思いをライブに乗せて届けようとする。フラワーバズリウムチェンジを達成し、第4回アイプリコンテストの出場も決めたつむぎ。だが、その歌声はどこか切なかった……。一方のリング姫も、つむぎの思いにどう答えれば良いか分からず、ひとり悩んでいた。

tvdb.synopsis: Tsumugi visits Princess Ring. Princess Ring says there is still a lot she doesn't know. Tsumugi tells her she will teach her many things and they make a promise to meet the next day at lunchtime. In order to learn more, Tsumugi goes to the Paradise Academy library disguised as Mugi-chan. Tsumugi is excited to teach Princess Ring even more. However, she becomes so engrossed in the book that she forgets her promise to Princess Ring...

episodes.synopsis: 仲直りしようと、たくさんのプレゼントを手にリング姫の元を訪れたつむぎ。しかしリング姫は、つむぎを帰らせてしまう。一人ひみつの庭にいるリング姫の元に、みつきがやってくる。「羽のついた指輪」と「星の形をしたキャンディ」を交換した相手が、幼い頃のみつきであったことを思い出すリング姫。ひみつの庭にいる彼女は、リング姫の過去の記憶であった。記憶の彼女はみつきに、アイプリバースにいるリング姫に「五つの心」を取り戻してやって欲しいと頼む。戻ったみつきは、リング姫とつむぎに「勇気」を届けようと、ひまりとライブをする。リング姫に謝り、大好きな気持ちを届けるつむぎ。リング姫もつむぎに謝り、「おともだちになってほしい」と言う。仲直りした二人はデュオを結成。フラワーバズリウムチェンジを達成し、見事、第4回アイプリコンテストの出場を決めるのだった。

tvdb.title: The Lonely Princess
tvdb.synopsis: Princess Ring is worried because she has not been able to make up with Tsumugi. Tsumugi, who is also worried, visits Chii. After hearing about how to make up, Tsumugi heads out. Meanwhile, Princess Ring has not filled up her ring gauge and cannot participate in the 4th AiPri Contest. The reason for this is that Princess Ring has no one to whom she wants to convey her feelings, in other words, no friends. Tsumugi comes to Princess Ring with many presents. However, Princess Ring sends Tsumugi home without accepting any. Princess Ring is alone in the secret garden when Mitsuki comes to her...

episodes.synopsis: いよいよ第4回アイプリコンテストが開幕。出場するのは、ひまりとみつきのデュオ・ポッピンドリーミンと、リング姫とつむぎのデュオ。つむぎは、ひまりとみつきに「おともだちだけど今回はライバル」と言い放つ。その後、つむぎはリング姫とのデュオに「光り輝く花」という意味の『ルミナスフローラ』と名付ける。そして、たくさんの人が見守る中、いよいよ始まるコンテスト。どちらのデュオも素晴らしいライブを披露する。だが、優勝に輝いたのはルミナスフローラだった。そう思われた矢先、リング姫がまさかのダブル優勝を宣言する。かくして第4回アイプリコンテストの優勝は、ルミナスフローラとポッピンドリーミンの二組となったのだった。

tvdb.synopsis: The 4th AiPri Contest is about to begin. The participants are the duo Poppin' Dreamin' who consist of Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa, and Luminous Flora who consist of Tsumugi Suzukaze and Ring Clover. Tsumugi declares, "We're friends, but this time we're rivals."

episodes.synopsis: お披露目ライブに向けて、ひまりもみつきもやる気じゅうぶん。最初のライブはルミナスフローラから。リング姫とつむぎは、誰もが見惚れるような圧巻のライブを披露する。そのすごさを目の当たりにしたみつきとひまりはなんと、お披露目ライブを辞退すると言い出した。ルミナスフローラのライブを見て、二人は大切なことに気づかされたのだ。それは、自分たちの弱さを認めること。いつかリング姫とつむぎと肩を並べて歌えると思った時に、一緒にライブをしようと誓うみつきとひまり。そんな二人に、エターナルフラワーコーデからのリクエストが届いた。それを受けたみつきとひまりは気持ちを新たに、再出発のライブをする。その後、第5回アイプリコンテストのテーマが発表される。テーマは『メロディバズリウムチェンジ』。アイプリたちは大集合し、みんな、エターナルアイプリになることを決意…

episodes.synopsis: パラダイス学園にサクラ、タマキ、アイリ、リンリンの四人が帰ってきた！しかし、どこか様子がおかしい。つむぎは言う。四人に「ダークカルテットスター」の匂いを感じると。だが、それは四人が仕掛けたドッキリだった。その後、サクラたちはリング姫に会うため、アイプリバースへ。リング姫にデュエル・オーディションを申し込む。それを受けたリング姫は、ルミナスフローラとしてライブを披露。対するカルテットスターは、なんといきなりメロディバズリウムチェンジを達成して見せた。サクラはリング姫に尋ねる。かつて五つのバズリウムチェンジを成功させ、『プリンセスの奇跡』を起こしたのはあなたなのか、と。覚えていない……そう答えるリング姫。アイプリコンテストとは、リング姫の五つの心を取り戻すために開かれたものだったことが判明。カルテットスターは、次のコンテストで優勝し…

tvdb.synopsis: Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin have returned to Paradise Academy! However, something seems strange. Everyone exudes a sharp, stern aura. Tsumugi says that she senses the scent of a "Dark Quartet Star" among the four Quartet Stars. Mitsuki tries to find out the truth about what happened to Sakura and the others. Have Sakura and the other four really become Dark Quartet Stars...?

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: 今日は進路を相談する三者面談の日。ひまりの将来の夢は、『アイプリをがんばって、おともだちを笑顔にする』こと。『留学して歌の勉強をする』というみつきの夢に対して、ひまりの夢はまだぼんやりとしている。いつかみつきとのお別れが来ることをさびしく思っているひまり。そんなひまりに、ママは今までひみつにしていた自分の気持ちを明かす。「『おともだちを笑顔にしたい』という気持ちがあれば、いつか絶対に自分の進む道も見つかる。何があっても、ママは信じてる。ひまりのこと、ずーっと見てるからね。」その言葉を聞いたひまりは、張り切ってみつきとのライブに臨む。みつきもまた、留学のことをカルテットスター四人に相談し、応援の言葉をもらう。周りから「信じてもらえている」と強く感じたひまりとみつきは、将来に向け、思いを新たにするのだった。

tvdb.synopsis: It's the day of the three-way meeting to discuss their future paths. While Mitsuki's dream is to study abroad and study singing, Himari's dreams are still vague. Then, Himari's mother reveals her feelings to her.

episodes.synopsis: 三者面談の日、サクラから「羽ばたきたい気持ちがあるのなら、できるだけ早いほうがいい」と言われていたみつき。留学を早めたほうが良いのか悩んでいる。そして、もうすぐクリスマス。パラダイス学園はその準備で、みんな楽しそう。そんな中、みつきは思い出していた。昔、クリスマスの頃に一人のアイプリと出会っていたことを。みつきはそのアイプリと、星の形をしたキャンディと羽のついた指輪を交換した。そのアイプリの名前はリング・クローバー。その正体は、今もよく知るわこ先生だった。だが、わこ先生は事故により、過去の記憶を失っていた。そして更科先生は、妹のわこ先生が記憶を取り戻した時、アイプリブレスを渡そうと思っていた。一方、ひまりたちはクリスマス直前スペシャルライブでプリトモたちを盛り上げる。来年のクリスマスは一緒にいられないかもしれない。そう思いながら…

Mitsuki is wondering if it would be better to speed up her study abroad. Christmas is just around the corner. Everyone at Paradise Academy seems to be having fun preparing for Christmas. Meanwhile, Mitsuki is remembering something. She once met an AiPri around Christmas time. Mitsuki exchanged star-shaped candy and a winged ring with that AiPri. That AiPri's name was Ring Clover. But even now, she knows her true identity well...

episodes.synopsis: 今日は特別企画、アイプリのみんなで『クリスマス・ウィンターフェス』をお届け！ジャンピンロケット、カルテットスター、ビビアンチィのライブにつづいて、じゅりあ、える、すばる、みつきのソロライブも披露。最高潮の盛り上がりを見せる中、そこにリング姫も登場。楽しそうなイベントがうらやましかったようだ。そんなリング姫も加わり、ウィンターフェスは後半戦へ。プリトモたちの熱は、さらに高まっていく！

tvdb.synopsis: Today we have a special project, bringing you a "Christmas Winter Festival" with everyone from Aipri! Following live performances by Jumpin' Rocket, Quartet Star, and Vivi & Chii, Julia, Elle, Subaru, and Mitsuki also performed solo live shows. As the excitement reached its climax, Princess Ring also appeared. It seemed she was envious of the fun-looking event. With Princess Ring joining in, the Winter Festival moved into the second half. The excitement of the Pritomo members is rising even more!

tvdb.synopsis: Mitsuki is asked by a famous song producer to send a promotional video. Upon hearing this, Himari declares that she will be the director and make the promotional video. With the help of Tsumugi, Hinata, Yakumo, and Hiiro, they begin filming. Under the cold sky, they somehow manage to finish filming. They were supposed to gather everyone together for a unveiling party, but Himari made a mistake in the controls and the filmed footage was lost. They try to re-shoot it, but Mitsuki ends up with a fever... What will Himari do?

episodes.synopsis: もうすぐ第５回アイプリコンテスト。出場して、アイプリバースのひみつも解き明かすと意気込むサクラたち。アイリは、コンテストに向けて勝負をかける新曲が必要だと考えていた。次のライブまでに新曲を完成させると豪語するアイリ。アイプリたちに取材をし、新曲のイメージを膨らませていく。その後、みつきと話す中で「ライブをするだけではなく、ライブそのものも作ってみたい」という自身の夢を再認識するアイリ。しかし、未だ新曲が出来ないプレッシャーに悩んでいた。果たして、カルテットスターの新曲は完成するのだろうか？

tvdb.synopsis: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Sakura and the others are excited to enter and uncover the secrets of the Aipriverse. Airi has decided that she needs a new song to put her all on the line for the contest. Airi boasts that she will have the new song completed by the next live performance. She interviews the Aipri and the others and expands on the image of the new song. Later, while talking with Mitsuki, Airi reaffirms her dream of "not just performing a live performance, but creating the live performance itself." However, she is troubled by the pressure of not being able to write a new song yet. Will Quartet Star be able to complete their new song?

Mitsuki has decided to tell Himari that after the contest she will be studying abroad in the spring, and that she only has three more months to be with her. And finally, the day of the contest arrives. Poppin' Dreamin' and Quartet Star will be on stage. Mitsuki tells Himari that there is something she wants to talk to her about after the contest is over. Himari also asks Mitsuki for a date on Valentine's Day. Even though she senses that Mitsuki will soon be gone, Himari takes on the challenge of the contest.

Mitsuki becomes worried when Himari disappears from her room. Meanwhile, after receiving "certain words" from teacher Wako, Mitsuki decides to tell Himari that "we'll be saying goodbye in three months." However, Himari doesn't want to hear them and starts running away from Mitsuki...
